prompt: Create an original 60 second acoustic minimalism instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: marimba, piano, muted strings. Style: phase-shifted repeating figures with small harmonic changes. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; D major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A classical-style instrumental piece featuring piano and strings, evolving from a gentle, reflective opening to a more dramatic and emotional section.
description.zh: 一首古典风格的器乐作品，以钢琴和弦乐为主，从柔和、沉思的开场发展到更具戏剧性和情感的段落。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
